novelty_flags.label: Theorem 1 (sharp replacement radius)
novelty_flags.one_line: The flagship-framed radius is a strict theorem only against RothenhauslerEtAl2015BackShift; AkhavanEtAl2020GeometryJD is explicitly only informed-by, so the result has no two-comparator or generic-class chain and is capped at field.

novelty_flags.label: bibliography and related-work references to AkhavanEtAl2020GeometryJD
novelty_flags.one_line: The cited IET article is a 2019 publication, not 2020; the publisher gives Volume 13, Issue 9, pages 755–765, first published 1 December 2019.

soundness_flags.label: ass:invariant-noise-spd
soundness_flags.one_line: BACKSHIFT permits a positive-semidefinite invariant error covariance; positive definiteness is a stronger restriction and cannot be tagged as its standard cited condition.

soundness_flags.label: ass:all-slots-spd
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited BACKSHIFT assumptions do not require every observed covariance slot to be positive definite; retag this as a justified new data-domain restriction or weaken it.

soundness_flags.label: ass:generic-active-amplitudes
soundness_flags.one_line: BACKSHIFT Corollary 2 assumes independent fully continuous intervention variances, not merely joint absolute continuity conditional on an arbitrary fixed sparse support pattern.

soundness_flags.label: Lemma 1 (overlap uniqueness)
soundness_flags.one_line: The lemma introduces two explanations but only one shift family s; it must specify that the affine clouds are those of the designated first explanation on its honest-set intersection.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 2 (consensus completeness)
soundness_flags.one_line: As defined, SubsetConsensus enumerates subsets and retains exactly the feasibility witnesses defining R_c, so “returns exactly R_c” and the binomial call count are a definitional enumeration rather than a substantive proposition.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 2–3, Section 2.3 assumptions (A)–(C), equations (5)–(7); p. 4, Theorem 1 and Corollary 2
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper assumes an invariant noise distribution and diagonal intervention covariance, states no positive-definite requirement on the invariant noise or every observed covariance slot, and its Corollary 2 uses independent intervention variances absolutely continuous over variables and environments.

source_verification_receipts.version: IET Signal Processing, Volume 13 Issue 9, publisher version
source_verification_receipts.locator: article metadata and recommended citation; Section 4.2, equations (42) and the threshold update
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The publisher lists first publication on 1 December 2019 and cites the article as Akhavan, Esmaeili, and Soltanian-Zadeh (2019), pp. 755–765; Section 4.2 uses a threshold to select non-outlier target matrices.

The paper studies sparse changing causal mechanisms and causal-structure identification via pairwise environments, not covariance BACKSHIFT affine occupancy or adversarial covariance-slot replacement.

source_verification_receipts.version: SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications 43(2), publisher abstract
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article concerns finite Hermitian simultaneous diagonalization by congruence, including a positive-definite feasibility system and a polynomial-time numerical algorithm; it does not itself state a BACKSHIFT maximum-consensus result.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv v3, 2012; the IEEE 2013 primary text was not publicly inspectable in this review
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The accessible preprint gives essential uniqueness of a complete non-unitary joint-diagonalization family iff its diagonal profiles have collinearity modulus below one; it does not address adversarial subset overlap.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the two SPD tags by either the published PSD BACKSHIFT condition plus the minimum observed-covariance condition actually needed, or retag the PD domain as novel and justify a measurement-noise setting where it is appropriate.
State overlap uniqueness with two fully named explanations and designate the true explanation’s shift cloud; then make the h-c overlap subset explicit in the theorem’s sufficiency proof route.

Turn SubsetConsensus into a genuine constructive result: specify the exact semialgebraic or SDP feasibility subroutine, its output representation, and a bit-complexity or termination guarantee, rather than defining it to retain R_c witnesses.

Either present the radius as field-tier “informed by robust JD” or add a second named robust causal/JD comparator and a theorem showing a strict frontier against it, thereby clearing the comparator-chain floor.

recommended_next_step: Revise the assumption tags and lemma/procedure formulations, correct the Akhavan citation, and retain the exact replacement-radius kernel as a field-tier target unless a second strict comparator is developed.
